def shift_letter(letter, shift=3):
    if 'a' <= letter <= 'z':
        return chr((ord(letter) - ord('a') + shift) % 26 + ord('a'))
    elif 'A' <= letter <= 'Z':
        return chr((ord(letter) - ord('A') + shift) % 26 + ord('A'))
    return letter

def shift_string(s, shift=3):
    return ''.join(shift_letter(char, shift) for char in s)

supplier_name = "Selhurst Outfitters"
shifted_name = shift_string(supplier_name)
print(shifted_name)
